experiment: ALFWorld LoRA rank 32, optimized training path

processing.deduplication_rule: Read scalar records in source-file order and retain the last record for each trainer step. Steps 101 and 102 were rerun after restoring checkpoint 100.
processing.missing_values: Empty CSV cells mean the metric was not logged. No zero filling or interpolation is applied.

entropy.reason: The server-loss training log does not emit actor/entropy_loss.

processing.runners_assignment: Assign concurrency from the documented configuration stages to the retained training trajectory; this is not a per-step scalar emitted by trainer.log.

runners.meaning: Configured rollout runner count for the retained stage

training_stages.note: This stage originally reached step 102; those two scalar records are superseded by the next stage.

start.event: Trainer synchronized weights at step 0 before training step 1.

source_evidence.checkpoint_metadata: trainer_meta.json and both latest-iteration pointer files record 250.
source_evidence.timestamp_note: Times are preserved as logged; the trainer log does not encode a timezone.
source_evidence.interpretation: The final trajectory covers all 250 steps after deduplication, but includes three planned restarts and concurrency changes. It is not a fixed-configuration uninterrupted run.

best_10_step_window.metric: training score; not checkpoint test success

limitations: The checkpoints use the same task set and evaluation protocol but different random seeds.
Two repeats on each of 140 games are not 280 distinct independent test tasks.
Action-parse failure counts are log-message counts, not failed-episode counts; no call-level failure rate is derived.
The report's approximate 38,000-call denominator is not verified and is not used here.
Observed success differences do not isolate a causal effect of the speed changes.

evidence_limits: Training score is a statistic of sampled training batches, not held-out success rate.
Runner counts and optimized training code both differ from the original run; the comparison is not a single-variable experiment.
The final trajectory is reconstructed from saved records without rerunning training or evaluation.
This public provenance intentionally omits private machine paths and run identifiers.
